locale.title: 界面语言 / UI language
locale.description: auto 跟随 ECHO 界面语言。/ auto follows the ECHO UI language.

confirmBeforeUpload.title: 上传前确认 / Confirm before upload
confirmBeforeUpload.description: 自定义上传前弹出确认。主进程仍会拒绝非官方榜单。/ Renderer confirms custom uploads. Main still refuses unknown boards.

alsoSyncUserStats.title: 同时同步用户统计 / Also sync user stats
alsoSyncUserStats.description: 官方同步排行榜后，再按只增策略写入 ECHO_STAT_* 用户统计。/ After official leaderboard sync, also store ECHO_STAT_* user stats (max of remote and local).

allowCustomScores.title: 允许自定义分数 / Allow custom scores
allowCustomScores.description: 关闭后侧栏隐藏自定义上传，主进程也会拒绝。官方同步仍可用。/ When off, custom upload is blocked in UI and main. Official sync still works.

defaultBoard.title: 默认排行榜 / Default board
defaultBoard.description: 自定义上传与下载条目的默认榜单。/ Default board for custom upload and entry download.

defaultScore.title: 默认分数 / Default score
defaultScore.description: 自定义上传的默认分数（0 表示使用本地聆听统计对应字段）。范围 0–2147483647。/ Default custom-upload score (0 uses the matching local listening-stats field). Clamped 0–2147483647.

defaultScope.title: 默认下载范围 / Default download scope
defaultScope.description: global 全球前 50；around-user 附近；friends 好友。/ global top 50, around-user, or friends.
